arms.name: direct_silhouette
arms.role: primary, selected by the stage-3 rule

arms.name: direct_box
arms.role: primary comparator (best arm of held-out v1)

negative: blurry, low quality, distorted, deformed, watermark, text
primary_endpoint: Sketch fidelity per image (ocsd/sketch_fidelity.py, SAM ViT-H box prompt on each instance target box vs the raw sketch ink): facing_acc (ink fits the outline better than its mirror; asymmetric drawings only) and sketch_chamfer (lower is better).
analysis: Unit = scene (18); per-scene value = mean over seeds (facing_acc over eligible instances; scenes without an eligible instance drop out of that test).
Primary: exact two-sided sign test over scenes, Holm over the two primary tests; paired bootstrap CIs over scenes.

Secondary (CIs only): the same two metrics for direct_silhouette vs ControlNet and vs OCSD soft-matte; OWLv2 count accuracy/OPR/count error/mIoU/relations/joint layout success and CLIP for all pairs; analyst review of the 36 sheets (count/colour/shape/naturalness), done blind to the key before unblinding; the user checks hard cases only.

Claim rule: silhouette conditioning is called better at following sketch shape/pose only if both primary tests are significant after Holm, or one is and the other points the same way; it is called better overall only if OWLv2 count accuracy and the analyst structure success are not worse (CI of the difference includes or exceeds 0).
Results by object-count bin (3, 5, 8+) are descriptive only.
Cost: wall time, sampling calls and peak memory per arm, not called equal FLOPs.
limits: InstanceDiffusion is an external generator (Wang et al., CVPR 2024); OCSD contributes the sketch parser.

The fidelity metric uses SAM and raw sketch ink; SAM errors and interior sketch lines add noise equally to all arms. The silhouette arm sees a mask parsed from the same sketch, so chamfer partly measures that it obeys its input; facing (mirror test) is the less circular measure.
Analyst review is by the method author and not fully blind (styles are recognisable); it is secondary.

fidelity.segmenter: facebook/sam-vit-huge (box prompt, best of 3 masks by predicted IoU)
